name: L3 First lit frame
body: Port `renderer-3d` and `sdl-gpu`: primitives, glTF and PNG loading, the camera, `RenderWorld`, the three pipelines and depth buffer recreation on resize.

comments.text: Split into three PRs: L3a render data and bitmap text (14 tests, one of them new for RenderWorld's overlay and debug lines), L3b PNG and glTF loading, L3c the SDL GPU backend and the lit scene.

plan: Two PRs: the first carries the backend-neutral stories (render data, asset loading, bitmap text) with their 16 ported tests, the second the SDL GPU backend and the lit scene. Lantern's L3 cards ride in each. The Mac check ends the milestone with a request to Dean.

acceptance_criteria.text: A lit scene with a glTF mesh and a PNG texture draws on Dean's Mac
The same build runs against the stub SDL in cloud sessions

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
